errors.evidence: The description only mentions the colors of the bars and fails to describe the distinct fill patterns (diagonal stripes, horizontal stripes, and solid fill) that are used in the legend and on the bars to differentiate the categories.
The 'no SFT' bar for LLaMA-2-7B has a value of approximately 4%, not 6%. The bar is clearly below the 5% mark.

The bar for '+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂' for LLaMA-2-70B reaches approximately 50.5%, the highest value on the chart. The value of 45% corresponds to the '+ SFT on D₀' bar within the same group, indicating a misreading of the chart.
